project_name: LexKasa - Hukuk Bürosu Finans ve Kasa Yönetim Sistemi
design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS RIGOR (Law Firm Trust, Precision, Sovereign Vaults)

theme_strategy.aesthetic: Prestigious Legal Swiss Office meets Modern Wealth Vault. Warm ivory alabaster surfaces, deep midnight slate typography, rich imperial bronze/gold accents (#C5A059), bespoke banking vault borders, and crisp tabular ledger alignment.

responsive.mobile_rules: Start with w-full, single-column flex-col layout on mobile (360px - 768px), then grid-cols-2 at md (768px) and grid-cols-4 / grid-cols-12 at lg (1024px+).

layout.mobile: Single column flow, sticky top legal bar with responsive drawer toggle, 4 Kasa cards rendered as a horizontal swipeable ribbon or clean stacked tactile cards, drawer/modal sheet for quick money transfers.
layout.desktop: Sidebar fixed or collapsible (w-64), top institutional action ribbon, 4-column Kasa Vault grid, 12-column Bento ledger & case distribution with instant transfer drawer and analytical ledger.

responsive.typography: Mobile base text-sm to text-base (never below 14px for inputs to prevent iOS auto-zoom), headings scaled clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.25rem). Strict tabular numbers (font-mono or tabular-nums) for all Turkish Lira currency balances.
responsive.overflow_guard: All tables wrapped in overflow-x-auto with touch-scrolling. All card containers have max-w-full overflow-hidden. No unexpected horizontal page drift.
responsive.tap_targets: All mobile action buttons (Hızlı Transfer, Masraf Ekle, Makbuz Kes, Kasa Değiştir) have minimum height of 44px (h-11 or h-12) with px-4.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. TURKISH LANGUAGE: All labels, status badges, buttons, tooltips and mock data MUST be natural, professional legal Turkish (e.g. 'Müvekkil Cari Hesabı', 'Adli Harç Masrafı', 'Akdi Avukatlık Ücreti', 'İcra Tahsilat Kasası', 'Virman', 'Mahsup').
2. 4 KASA SYSTEM IS CENTRAL: There MUST be 4 distinct vaults prominently rendered with balances in Turkish Lira (₺). Provide explicit transfer capability: Kasa 1 <-> Kasa 2, Kasa <-> Müvekkil.

3. MOBILE FIRST: The user might open this from a smartphone in a courthouse. Ensure all modals convert smoothly to drawers/sheets or fit mobile screens without clipping. Tables must scroll horizontally or format into clean mobile transaction cards.
4. NO MUDDY GRADIENTS: Use clean solid card backgrounds with 1px border strokes (#E2E8F0 light, #1E293B dark), crisp gold/bronze badges, and monospace figures for amounts.
5. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every button, input, tab, card, and action modal carries meaningful kebab-case data-testid attributes (see test_id_conventions).
6. USE RECHARTS: Provide income/expense trend charts and vault balance distribution charts with accessible Turkish labels.
7. JWT AUTH & DEMO ACCESS: Keep clean simulated or actual JWT authentication flow with quick-fill demo buttons for partner attorneys and managing accountants.
8. FULL FUNCTIONALITY: Users must be able to test transfers in real-time with instant state updates on vault balances and ledger transactions.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.aesthetic_principles: Avoid AI slop, avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical Bento grids, prestigious legal serif headings paired with high-clarity modern body fonts, and precise tabular numbers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion: Use Framer Motion for modal transitions, tab switches, and badge status changes. Strictly respect prefers-reduced-motion.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for transfer confirmations, expense creation notifications, and export success alerts.
